newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound up against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound up against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound rose slightly against the dollar on Thursday in a private sector market which bankers said was seeing more inflows of the U.S. currency.
A shortage of dollars had straddled the market for the weeks ahead of the end of the government's fiscal year. The new year began on July 1.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3920 and 3.3950 bid and at between 3.3935 and 3.3970 offered in the interbank market.
The average rate on Thursday was 3.39325 bid and 3.395625 offered. These averages compare to 3.3937 pounds bid and 3.3962 pounds offered on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.390291 buy and 3.395666 sell.
